request.name: dashboard-embed-info
request.comment: Uses a real, pre-existing board id (b_73c6fcc1 'Sample — Visitors', embed already enabled) found in console.bi_board — the literal string 'default' is rejected by this handler (400) so it cannot be used as the happy-path example. D2 (post-cutover): the captured TypeScript response also had a top-level `secret` field (the raw HMAC embed-signing key) which the Rust handler deliberately no longer returns — see rust/tests/parity/README.md's 'Intentional post-cutover divergences' section. This is the one corpus entry edited to remove a field rather than merely normalize its value.
